description: This file is a Java test class named 'HttpPublisherErrorTest' that tests error handling and resilience of an HTTP publisher actor in the context of a messaging system, specifically within the Eclipse Ditto project. It contains multiple JUnit test methods that simulate server failures and connection timeouts to verify correct behavior of the system.

classes.description: Java test class for verifying error handling and connection resilience of the HttpPublisherActor component in the messaging system.
